operations.name: Saw – Cut Tube Blanks
operations.setup_note: Support the precision seamless tube in a tube-compatible vice without crushing the wall, and set the length stop for 100 mm blanks. These blanks provisionally serve configuration 080300, using the tabulated finished-length limits rather than the scale-derived length.

operations.name: CNC Turn – First End
operations.setup_note: Grip the second-end OD in bored, broad-contact soft jaws with controlled clamping pressure and unobstructed through-bore clearance; face the exposed end to establish the process axial reference. Size the complete through bore before skimming the exposed OD, then cut the specified internal chamfer and break the exposed external edge to 0.5 mm maximum.

operations.name: CNC Turn – Second End
operations.setup_note: Reverse the part into protective bored soft jaws on the finished OD, locating the first finished end against an annular axial stop with low clamping pressure. Face to the tabulated overall length, skim the previously gripped OD band with a controlled blend, and cut the second internal chamfer plus the remaining external edge break.

operations.name: Final Shop-Floor Gauge Inspection
operations.setup_note: Check the unclamped, temperature-stabilized parts using OD snap gauges, bore plug gauges and a length gauge under the shop SPC sampling plan. Verify both internal chamfers and confirm that remaining edges satisfy the 0.5 mm maximum break requirement; no CMM layout or functional test is specified.

clarifications.question: Should finished dimension A for configuration 080300 use the tabulated limits of 93.17–93.67 mm rather than the extraction's scale-derived 65 mm assumption?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use the explicit 080300 table limits of 93.17–93.67 mm, with a nominal target of 93.42 mm.

clarifications.question: Which specific SAE grade within the stated 1010–1026 range is required?
clarifications.suggested_default: Provisionally source SAE 1020 precision seamless mechanical tube, subject to customer approval.

clarifications.question: Which commercially available precision seamless tube size is approved for this order?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use provisional sourcing dimensions of 155.00 mm OD and 141.70 mm ID; verify commercial availability and incoming tolerances before releasing blanks.

assumptions.text: The order is for configuration 080300. Its explicit dimension-A table limits, 93.17–93.67 mm, supersede the inherited 65 mm scale-based estimate; the 100 mm blank provides 6.58 mm total facing allowance relative to the 93.42 mm midpoint.
Configuration 080300 has PROCESS: NONE. The PS-119.0 and PS-135.6 requirements belong to other configurations and are not applied to this route.

The provisional tube procurement envelope is 155.00 mm OD by 141.70 mm ID, pending confirmation of an available commercial size. This provides only light OD cleanup and bore sizing; machining_allowance_mm represents approximately 0.2 mm radial finishing stock.

The supplied tube is unhardened, clean precision stock without a heavy scale layer. Light single-pass finish turning and finish boring replace roughing under the organizational near-net-stock corrections.
The global tube axis is X. F01 represents the two internal bore-entry chamfers accessed from opposite axial ends; its detail-view Z notation is local and does not require milling.
No drawing datums are defined. The tube axis and first finished end are process locating references only, so datum_references remains empty.

A through-clearance first-end fixture permits finish boring the entire bore in the first lathe setup. Bore finishing precedes OD finishing to limit thin-wall distortion; the second setup finishes only the remaining OD band and opposite end, without redundant bore sizing.

Center drilling and tailstock support are omitted because the part is short and hollow. Hole-making spotting, pilot drilling, full-size drilling and peck drilling are omitted because the bore already exists in the tube.

Reaming and honing are omitted because the specified 0.13 mm bore tolerance can be achieved by finish boring. Grooving, threading, tapping and fastener recess operations are omitted because no corresponding features are present.
Lathe part-off is omitted because the saw supplies individual blanks. Both sawn ends receive explicit facing operations.

The lathe chamfer passes remove bore-entry and exit burrs and break both external end edges to 0.5 mm maximum. No residual inaccessible edges are expected, so a separate production bench deburr/clean gate is omitted.

VMC machining, heat treatment, coating and grinding are omitted because configuration 080300 specifies no applicable features or processes. Exactly one final manual gauge inspection is used, with no intermediate inspection or sampled functional test added.

Saw cutting, end facing and general external edge breaks use empty target lists because the graph contains no dedicated blank, end-face or general edge-break feature IDs. Inspection also uses an empty target list because it does not physically produce geometry.
